newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 30.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 30.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones dropped by 64.73 points to 5,647.65. PLDT's ADR edged up by $ 1/8 to $60.
* The peso closed at 26.217 to a U.S.dollar from 26.201.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,215.79, up 14.81.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate was unchanged at 10.90625 percent.

* The Philippine Daily Inquirer said the Philippine Stock Exchange postponed the start on Thursday of the initial public offering of Music Semiconductors Corp due to failure of the underwriter to deliver the IPO's selling kits to the brokers.

* Jonas Ferrer at Pryce Securities recommended a buy on glass manufacturing firm Republic Glass and real estate firm Universal Rightfield. Republic Glass has tremendous upside potential because its a virtual monopoly in the manufacture of industrial glass in the local market while Universal Rightfield has considerable property development backlogs worth 20 billion pesos as of end June this year, Ferrer said.

* The Manila Times said Ayala Land and Hong Kong Land are teaming up to built two residential towers in Makati that will cater to the very rich people here and abroad. The twin towers will be the msot expensive in the country and its construction cost is estimated at 5.5 billion pesos.
